note: Summaries of three short node CPU profiles (dev build hazelLib.bc.js of hazel-lib from js-library-embed 0d66c36618, about 3 s each, one process at a time). The raw .cpuprofile files are too big to keep and are summarized here. Shares are of all sampled time; profiled times run long, so the shares matter, not the times.

flat_16x16_nope.what: 16x16 World call with a 'Nope' event that goes straight to | _ => Done (13.8 ms p50 unprofiled, minified)

deep_annotated_find.what: World call with the target last, shipped rule

held_closure_walk_16x16.what: a walk of 136 steps over a list converted once and held in a closure, 13.5 ms/call
